description: Amazon is a global technology leader with an expansive infrastructure footprint, operating extensive data center networks across North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, while maintaining major corporate hubs like HQ2 in Arlington, Virginia, and investing heavily in global cloud computing, AI partnerships, and sustainable energy initiatives.

Alphabet Inc. is a global technology holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California, that operates through its primary subsidiary, Google, and various 'Other Bets.' With a massive international presence, the company maintains offices and data centers across six continents, spanning nearly 60 countries and over 200 cities. Its global infrastructure supports a wide range of services, including Google Services, Google Cloud, and autonomous vehicle technology through Waymo, while managing significant capital investments in technical infrastructure across North America, Europe, Asia, and South America.

Microsoft Corporation is a global technology leader headquartered in Redmond, Washington, operating a massive, interconnected infrastructure of over 400 data centers across 70 regions worldwide. The company provides cloud computing services through Azure, develops AI-driven software and hardware, and maintains a significant international presence with operations, research facilities, and data center campuses spanning North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.
